## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^icbp-be4bae821fb86c38]

Rank 1 is No actionable strategy because Neutral/Wait is unconfirmed and first-target economics fail: hypothetical 6,975/6,749/7,168 yields only 0.85:1 gross. The 1.70:1 second-target ratio to 7,360 cannot rescue it. Rank 2 rejects a close above 6,975 requiring volume ratio toward/above 1 and CMF/OBV/ADL stabilization. The existing 6,975 close equals rather than exceeds confirmation. A later execution price and maximum buy are unsupported, so no order is authorized. Closing invalidation remains about 6,749. A session-4 close signal leaves insufficient follow-through time for earliest session-5 entry. Any future refreshed qualifying plan would require follow-through by holding-session 2. No profit fractions, costs or fill are supplied.[^icbp-be4bae821fb86c38]

The report keeps signals separate from fills: Waiting is the stated cut-off condition; Armed/Triggered need fresh dated observations, Active needs explicit entry execution, and Completed needs fills closing the full position. Target touches or exit deadlines alone do not prove execution. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot establish conditional target/stop/fill probabilities, so strategy expected value is not reliably estimable. Unknown costs are not zero and capital, currency-risk, lot and execution inputs do not support a share quantity.[^icbp-be4bae821fb86c38]
